reference.title: Product B: Adverse Reactions
reference.shortdesc: Summary of adverse events and hemodynamic reactions associated with Product B administration.

section.title: Common Adverse Reactions

section.title: Serious Adverse Reactions
section.p: Potentially life-threatening hemodynamic disturbances requiring immediate monitoring or treatment cessation:

ul.li: Symptomatic AV Block: First-degree or Mobitz Type I AV block observed in 2% of patients. Discontinue infusion if high-grade AV block develops.
Severe Hypotension / Shock: Rapid BP drop requiring IV fluids or vasopressor support observed in 1.5% of patients.
Ventricular Arrhythmia: Isolated cases of non-sustained ventricular tachycardia reported during rapid intravenous bolus administration.

section.title: Internal Review Notes
section.p: These notes are intended for internal regulatory review and should not be included in patient-facing materials.
Adverse reaction data is based on clinical trial populations; post-marketing surveillance may yield additional insights.
Ensure that all adverse reaction frequencies are updated in accordance with the latest clinical trial data and post-marketing reports.
